book.name: Mateselonika no matatekelo
book.title: Elin̄olo lya paulusi no matatekelo ku MATESELONIKA

content: Paulusi, Silubanus, ni Timoteya ku keleke no Matesolonika mwa Nyambe Sitetu ni Mbumu Jesu Kilesite. Esishemo ni kozo iikale naanyi.
Paulusi yo ku Tumela kwa Nyambe ku Oupilo ni Tumelo no Matesalonika.
Kame tukutumela kwa Nyambe onene mulibaka lyenu moonje mi kame tutwalelela oku milapelela mu titapelo tetu.
Abo kame tumihupula balubala waye Nyambe wetu ni sitetu ku musebezi wenu no tumelo ni misebezi no lilato ni kongoteteta mu kusepa Mbumu Jesu Kilesite.
Abeetu kame tulimukile nji Nyambe kame amisinga mi namikete nji mutende aye luli,
kakuli eliywi no kuwaba lyetu kalya sikwiiya feela mu liywi, kono kame ni maata ni mu mebo no kukena ni mukuyupisisa onene. Mulimukile omu tuna kwikalela mukaci kenu mulibaka lyenu.
Namutu fanikete ni Mbumu, simba nji na mu kuyanda, na mutambula eliywi okutunda ku mebo no kukena mu kuwabelelwa.
Abo cwale mutende omwaanda kwa sikupumena onje mu Mesodoniya ni mu Akaya.
Kakuli kasa feela eliywi lya Mbumu lina kuyupahala onene okutunda kwaanyi mu Mesodoniya ni mu Akaya, kono etumelo yenu mwa Nyambe naikuta kwibaka yonje, nji cwale ka tutwese okwamba esinjili.
Kakuli aanu no sibaka eso kame abiha okukumanena naaci ni kutambula eyo tunakuwana mukaci kenu, nomo munakufutukela kwa Nyambe okutunda ku milimu, nikusebeleza Nyambe no kuyoya ni niti
mi nikutatelela mwanaye okutunda kuwilu, woyo anakwingula kwafu Jesu wuyu otuyoyisa ku kutweba kwa Nyambe ukeyile.
